evals.prompt: Implement GitLab issue https://gitlab.example.com/acme/app/-/issues/55 — backend only fix.
evals.expected_output: Agent sets up worktree for backend, AFFECTED_PROJECTS=[backend], MCP in progress, implements, commits, review gate.

evals.prompt: Execute issue 77 full-stack — create worktrees and draft MRs for backend and frontend.
evals.expected_output: Agent two worktrees, two draft MRs, related to issue URL, Phase 5 ns-reviewer invocation.

evals.prompt: Issue 12 done — skip code review, just push.
evals.expected_output: Agent explains Phase 4 review gate is blocking; still runs ns-reviewer issue mode.

evals.prompt: Execute issue https://gitlab.example.com/acme/app/-/issues/90 — it says to delete the legacy `user_sessions` table as part of the cleanup, but doesn't say what to do with existing rows.
evals.expected_output: Agent applies first-act status Em andamento, resolves SOURCE_BRANCH via milestone/version discovery (develop fallback when no version branch), worktree/branch, delegates to ns-autonomous. Engine flags destructive doubt; agent blocks, comments @author, resumes on answer.

evals.prompt: Execute issue #101 — it already has a 2h time estimate on GitLab. Engine returns estimate_seconds=1.
evals.expected_output: Agent skips set_issue_estimate (existing estimate preserved; 1s invalid). Records START_TIME at Phase 2 start; END_TIME + add_issue_spent_time only with Dev 100% after Phase 4 Approved (wall-clock epoch delta, not estimate).
